question_pt: Qual e o mix de complexidade por carater de internacao?
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.CAR_INT,
        c.DESCRICAO AS carater,
        i.COMPLEX,
        cx.DESCRICAO AS complexidade,
        COUNT(*) AS internacoes
    FROM internacoes i
    LEFT JOIN car_int c
        ON i.CAR_INT = c.CAR_INT
    LEFT JOIN complexidade cx
        ON i.COMPLEX = cx.COMPLEX
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
), total AS (
    SELECT
        CAR_INT,
        carater,
        SUM(internacoes) AS total_carater
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    b.CAR_INT,
    b.carater,
    b.COMPLEX,
    b.complexidade,
    b.internacoes,
    ROUND(100.0 * b.internacoes / t.total_carater, 4) AS percentual_carater
FROM base b
JOIN total t
    ON b.CAR_INT = t.CAR_INT
   AND b.carater = t.carater
ORDER BY b.CAR_INT, percentual_carater DESC, b.COMPLEX
ground_truth_sql: SELECT comp.DESCRICAO AS complexidade, car.DESCRICAO AS carater, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN complexidade comp ON i.COMPLEX = comp.COMPLEX JOIN car_int car ON i.CAR_INT = car.CAR_INT GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY internacoes DESC
